Docs.param: A caller-chosen identifier, up to 256 characters, echoed on the matching result.
What the item is: a document (`text`, the default), a search query (`query`) or a document image (`image`).

The item, inline. For `text` and `query`: the text, up to 100,000 characters; text over the model's token limit (currently 8,192 tokens) isn't rejected: only its start is embedded, and the result is flagged with `truncated` and an `EMBEDDING_INPUT_TRUNCATED` warning. For `image`, only where the endpoint accepts inline images (off by default): a `data:image/...;base64,` URI or raw base64. The service never fetches URLs in `content`.

For `text` and `image` items, from Microsoft Entra callers, where enabled: the Azure Blob Storage URL of the blob to embed, `https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/{container}/{blob}`, with no query string. This is how images are sent by default. Text blobs are read as UTF-8, currently up to 1 MiB. Queries must be sent inline.

Required with `url`: a user delegation SAS for that one blob (its query string, with or without a leading `?`): read-only (`sp=r`), for the blob (`sr=b`), https-only (`spr=https`), and signed by the identity that calls this API. A SAS valid for more than 15 minutes is accepted with warning `EMBEDDING_SAS_LONG_LIVED`. The service uses it for one read and never stores, logs or returns it.
Docs.summary: One item to embed, defaulting to text: an optional `id` and exactly one source, `content` or `url` with `sasToken`.
